frame_assumption: Tag is mounted on the +X 30x30 cm box face. Tag +x points right on the face, tag +y points up, tag +z points outward toward the camera. Therefore box +X=tag +z, box +Y=tag +x, box +Z=tag +y. Box center is 200 mm behind the tag plane. In-plane center offset uses only opposite-edge differences, so it does not depend on the inconsistent summed gaps.
note: Measured tag family/id/size are now configured. The face/orientation convention above must be visually validated once: the AprilTag-derived box overlay should coincide with the physical box. If it appears on the wrong side or rotated, change only T_tag_box orientation/signs, not marker id/size. AprilTag is a reference estimate, not perfect ground truth.
